name: CDC Eastern Creek 5

address.note: Campus address; Lot 2 DP 1159804 per SSD-10330 SEARs request.

lat.note: Geocoded from street address via NSW Spatial Services address point for 17 ROBERTS ROAD EASTERN CREEK. Address point, not building centroid; campus spans a larger lot.

builder.note: Apollo Fabrication (6 Jan 2025): 'continue our partnership with Hindmarsh to deliver EC5 & EC6'. The Hindmarsh SSD-10330 CEMP (source 20) covers 'Four new buildings'.

mw_it.note: EC5+EC6 combined 108 MW ('add another 108 megawatts of capacity', ARN/IT Brief Dec 2022, verified, source 2). Per-building split not stated. ITK lists 79 MW each (per master.csv, not re-verified). The Mod-2 GHG assessment gives 'Maximum site capacity for modified business scenario 220 MW' for the whole six-building campus (source 25).

mw_grid.note: EIS: additional demand for Buildings 4, 5 and 6 'approximately 100MVA' combined (source 18), pre-Mod-1.

cost_aud_m.note: Additional A$1bn investment announced Dec 2022 for EC5 and EC6 together (source 2, verified); not apportioned. The SSD-10330 CIV of $291,465,000 (source 19) is RLB's construction cost for Buildings 4, 5 and 6 together, excluding M&E services and IT equipment.

authority.value: NSW Minister for Planning and Public Spaces (determined by DPIE Executive Director, Regions, Industry and Key Sites, under delegation)

reference.note: SSD-10330 covers Buildings 4, 5 and 6 (plus rooftop plant on existing Building E3). EC5 is SSD-10330 'Building 5' (Phase D). Mod-2 documents name the buildings EC5 and EC6 (source 23). Mod-1 raised Building 5's GFA to 27,835 m2 (source 22). Modifications: Mod-1 (Buildings 5 and 6 from 3 to 4 storeys; lodged 8 Dec 2023, approved 17 Apr 2024); Mod-2 (72 generators, up from 48, and diesel storage; lodged 9 Oct 2025, approved 6 Mar 2026); Mod-3 (HV plant; lodged 25 Jun 2026, approved 8 Sep 2026) (sources 22, 24, 26, 27).

lodged.note: EIS signed 22 Nov 2019 and uploaded to the portal 28 Nov 2019; exhibited 11 Dec 2019 - 31 Jan 2020 (source 15). Formal lodgement date not stated. SEARs requested 9 May 2019 and issued 2 Jul 2019.

determined.note: Notice of Decision dated 14 July 2020; portal Determination Date 14/07/2020 (source 14).

jobs_construction.note: Assessment Report: 'During construction works, there would be a maximum of 350 workers on-site at any given time, however this would vary significantly depending on the construction stage.' Covers the whole SSD-10330 expansion (Buildings 4, 5 and 6, built over up to five years), not this building alone; not apportioned.

jobs_construction_other.note: RLB CIV statement: 'We estimate the total number of construction jobs on this project to be 448.' EIS: 'It is estimated that a total of 448 construction job will be created.' Assessment Report: 'Employment 448 construction jobs'; Notice of Decision: 'the generation of 448 construction jobs' (source 15). Covers Buildings 4-6 together.

jobs_operational.note: EIS: 'On completion of the proposed development, it is estimated up to 10 full time equivalent job and 6 contract jobs could be generated by this site' (Operational Management Staff 6, Security Guards 4). Assessment Report: '10 full-time equivalent operational jobs'; Notice of Decision: 'up to 10 knowledge-intensive operational jobs'. Covers Buildings 4-6 together.

jobs_operational_other.note: EIS: 'Part time staff will comprise: Maintenance Contractors – 6' ('6 contract jobs'). Covers Buildings 4-6.

construction_start.note: Old estimate of 2023 (from the Dec 2022 'start construction ... next year') removed. Mod-1 Assessment Report (Apr 2024): 'Phases D and F have not commenced construction' and Phase E 'Building 6 not yet constructed' (source 22). Apollo won the EC5 & EC6 structural steel in Jan 2025 (source 1). Start date not confirmed.

construction_end.note: Taken as completed by the June 2026 quarter: Infratil (6 Jul 2026, source 29) says data centres 'became operational at the Eastern Creek (NSW)' campus in Apr-Jun 2026, with NSW operating capacity up from 150MW to 220MW; CDC website (Sep 2026, source 28) 'Eastern Creek has six operational data centres'. Infratil does not name buildings, so whether EC5 and EC6 each reached full operation, and the exact dates, are not confirmed. CDC website (accessed 2026-09-27): 'Eastern Creek has six operational data centres' (source 28), so EC5 is now taken to be operational; completion date not found. Sep 2025: CDC 'nearing completion of EC5/6' (source 4, snippet). The Mod-2 GHG assessment gives practical completion of the new generators as 2025/2026 (source 25). The Mod-3 Assessment Report (Sep 2026) still calls the SSD-10330 expansion 'currently under construction' (source 26). master.csv notes 103 MW added at Eastern Creek in the Mar-2026 quarter (Infratil Apr 2026 newsletter; infratil.com returns 403).

open_questions: mw_it per building not stated (108 MW combined with EC6; ITK 79 MW each)
cost is a combined EC5+EC6 figure; jobs figures are SSD-10330 totals for Buildings 4-6
status: operational on CDC website ('six operational data centres') plus Infratil Jun-2026 quarter ('became operational at the Eastern Creek' campus); exact completion date per building not published
